children: Positron raised an aggregate $2.0 million by issuing three unsecured promissory notes on September 30, 2026: $1.5 million to George Ortiz, $400,000 to TISU Investments, and $100,000 to an unrelated third party. Each note bears 20% annual interest, requires an interim interest payment equal to 10% of original principal after six months, and matures on September 30, 2027; prepayment is permitted without penalty. As additional consideration, Positron issued warrants to purchase 300,000, 80,000, and 20,000 shares, respectively, at a $2.00 exercise price through December 31, 2030. On the same date, Ortiz separately exercised prior warrants for 300,000 shares at $1.50, providing $450,000 in gross proceeds.
